title: rosa canina var. sarmentoides
intro: Rosa canina var. sarmentoides, commonly known as Dwarf or Prostrate Wild Rose, is a low-growing, trailing shrub that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may contribute to improved wound healing and immune system support. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. sarmentoides include anti-edematous and anti-oxidative properties, which may help in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which may be responsible for its medicinal effects, although further research is necessary to confirm its efficacy and potential applications.
